title: Rails detailed exception page disclosed in a response
description: The response carries the marker of a Rails detailed-exception page: a Rails exception class name or the "Extracted source" block. The page prints the request parameters, the session identifiers and the source lines around the failure, so serving it to a client discloses both code and request data.
remediation: Set config.consider_all_requests_local = false in production and render a static error page. Never deploy with the detailed exception renderer enabled.
limitation: One response body. The check recognises the page markers; it does not enumerate which parameters the page printed.

observation.body: Configure a custom error page for production deployments.
